title: Commits only on the current token after rotation (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17), option B (fixes CRY2-1 / IMP2-2 fork after removal): the moment a new admission key is registered, the sequencer stops stamping Commits on the old token's commit stream; the rotation grace period applies only to application messages. A member on the old key fetches the new key, then commits. The first Commit on the new stream references the last stamp of the old stream (existing closing rule).
